summary: Tested Portfolio + Page-hero upload pipeline (WEBP resize/compress) and alt_text wiring end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (WEBP output, max dims 1800/1920 respected, sizes under 200KB/220KB targets, alt_text persist on create/patch, 422 on >150 chars, 400 on non-image, 401 without auth, hero reset). Frontend: Admin Page heroes (alt input, upload with alt, thumbnail+toast update, alt persists after reload, Reset removes override + clears alt), Admin Portfolio (alt input with correct placeholder, upload w/ cat+caption+alt, form clears, edit shows 3 prefilled fields, Save persists all 3), public pages (/, /portfolio, /bridal-makeup-bangalore, /makeup-course-training-bangalore, /about-us) -> 0 broken images, 0 missing/empty/undefined alt; custom hero alt shows on /about-us; legacy portfolio items (alt_text '') fall back to caption. All 9 admin tabs load with no console errors. Two code-level defects found in the image helper (EXIF orientation, transparency).

critical.issue: EXIF orientation is ignored. Portrait phone photos (EXIF Orientation=6/8) get stored sideways after re-encoding to WEBP, because the re-encode drops EXIF and the pixels are never rotated. Reproduced: 400x200 JPEG with Orientation=6 is stored as 400x200 (should be 200x400). Fix: `from PIL import ImageOps; img = ImageOps.exif_transpose(Image.open(...))` before convert('RGB').

minor.issue: convert('RGB') on RGBA/transparent PNGs turns transparent areas black (verified pixel (0,0,0)). Paste onto a white or theme (#FBFAF7) background first.

For very detailed images, the fallback loop that shrinks at quality 40 can go far below max_dim (worst-case noisy 3000x4000 test image ended up as 691x921 for portfolio and 982x736 for the hero). Hero banners shown at full width could look soft. Consider a minimum dimension (e.g. stop at 1200px for heroes) or a higher target size for heroes.

The 8MB limit is checked on the raw upload before compression, so high-res DSLR exports (10-25MB) are rejected even though the server would compress them. This matches the UI copy, but you could raise the limit now that output is always compressed.
No resample filter is passed; LANCZOS would give sharper downscales. Also no Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS / decompression-bomb guard beyond Pillow's default warning.

integration_issues.issue: You can only save alt text by uploading a new image; there is no way to edit the alt of an existing hero on its own. Typing in the alt field and not clicking Change silently does nothing. Also, the Row's `alt` state is set once from `map` at mount (useState initializer), so if a row mounts before /content/page-images resolves, the input shows empty, and the next 'Change' sends alt_text='' and wipes the saved alt. In testing the cache was already warm, so this was not observed.

action_items: HIGH: Add ImageOps.exif_transpose() in images.to_webp before convert('RGB') so phone portrait photos are not stored sideways.
Flatten RGBA/LA/P-with-transparency images onto a white/theme background before converting to RGB.

Add a way to save hero alt text without re-uploading (e.g. PATCH /content/page-images/{slug} {alt_text} plus a Save button or save on blur), and sync the Row's alt state when `map` changes (useEffect on map[page.path]?.alt_text).
Optional: set a minimum dimension floor in the to_webp shrink loop (especially for heroes) and use Image.LANCZOS.
critical_code_review_comments: images.to_webp: no exif_transpose (orientation bug), alpha goes black, no resample filter, and the shrink fallback can over-downscale.

create_portfolio stores alt_text as `{caption} — makeup by Rekha Krishnamurthy` when none is given. That is good for SEO, but a later PATCH of the caption leaves the old caption inside alt_text, so alt and caption drift apart.
HeroImagesEditor Row: useState(() => map[...]) does not re-sync when the map loads or refreshes.
Legacy seeded portfolio docs have no alt_text field (the API returns ''); the frontend fallback `p.alt_text || p.caption` handles this correctly.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 API tests); 1 HIGH code defect found via direct unit check (EXIF)

seed_data_creation: None left behind. All TEST_ portfolio items were deleted by id and the /about-us hero override was reset. DATA INCIDENT (self-caused, fully restored): in one UI run my script picked the wrong grid item (the grid had not finished loading) and edited, then soft-deleted, the seeded portfolio item 67499b99-eb6b-4bf8-ad79-50b21cc377e8 ('Fashion · Runway'). I restored it directly in Mongo to cat=Fashion, caption='Fashion · Runway', is_deleted=False, with alt_text unset as it was originally. It is verified back in GET /api/content/portfolio at order 8.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with `-n 0` (the pytest.ini xdist flags need it): REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_iter16_image_pipeline.py -n 0. The test images must be smooth (noise generated at 1/4 size then upscaled); pure full-res noise JPEGs go over 8MB and get a 413. The test refuses to run if /about-us already has a custom hero. Upload takes about 5s. In Playwright, wait for the portfolio grid items to load before taking an id snapshot.
